description:
Time first, Weather ahead, at a glance.
A clean face, with room for what matters to you.

All features are free. Your support is welcome.
https://ko-fi.com/devjoe (Anywhere)
https://garmin.devjoe.app/tw-tip (Taiwan)

• A forecast that automatically switches between temperature and precipitation chance.
Tip: On supported touch watches, long-press the lower-left forecast to switch back to temperature when rain chance is shown.

AMOLED adds Weather Signals, Outdoor Brief and multiple Always-On Display styles. The temperature outlook covers 6 hours; precipitation adjusts to 3, 6 or 9 hours. Widgets, Weather Signals and Outdoor Brief are hidden in Always-On Display.

MIP uses dedicated layouts and a three-value, 3-hour outlook. Selected MIP watches also offer optional strong-wind signals with wind direction.

• English or Traditional Chinese weather and weekdays on supported watches. English is the default.

Count down to your next adventure. Keep track of days together. Keep someone far away a little closer. Add a Widget—or leave the space clear.

• Four Widget styles: Countdown, Days since, Analog and Digital second time zones. Choose separately for day and night.
Widget names support English letters and selected symbols.
Tip: On supported touch watches, enable "Hold Widget to show / hide" in settings, then long-press the left Widget area. Long-press the same area to show it again.

• Two customizable data fields for steps, distance, weekly run/ride totals and more. Weekly swim distance is available on supported watches, using activities saved on the watch.
• Four color themes, with separate day and night choices.
• A compact status rail for alarms, Do Not Disturb and notifications.

Weather and some readings depend on Garmin data and device setup. Unavailable readings show --.

Support and FAQ:
https://garmin.devjoe.app/burnished-sky-ahead/support/

whatsNew.title: 1.13.0 — Wind direction & more ways to track your week
paragraphs: Strong-wind Weather Signals now show wind direction, with support expanded to selected MIP watches. Weekly swim distance is available on more compatible watches, and MIP digital Widget digits are clearer.

whatsNew.title: 1.12.1 — Forerunner 255S joins the family
paragraphs: Now available on Forerunner 255S and 255S Music, with optional Traditional Chinese weather and weekdays. English remains the default.

whatsNew.title: 1.12 — More personal, easier to read
paragraphs: Choose English or Traditional Chinese weather and weekdays on supported watches. Widget names now adapt more naturally to the available space.
Add weekly swim distance from activities stored on your Forerunner 970. Support expands to Descent Mk2/Mk2i, Enduro 4, Approach S72 (43/47 mm) and MARQ Gen 3.
Note: Some FR970 updates may briefly show IQ!; leaving the watch face and returning can restore it.

whatsNew.title: 1.11 — Keep what matters close
paragraphs: Countdown, Days since, and analog or digital second time zones bring your plans and people onto your watch face. Add your own label, choose different Widgets for day and night, or keep the space clear. World clocks adjust automatically for daylight saving.
Clearer reading on AMOLED and MIP, with refined text sizes and more balanced MIP weekday, forecast and date typography.

whatsNew.title: 1.10 — Your data fields & refreshed MIP visuals
paragraphs: Customize the two lower data fields independently, with 11 choices including steps, distance, recovery time, sunrise and sunset. Redrawn MIP icons and refined fonts bring a cleaner display.

whatsNew.title: 1.9 — More ways to make it yours
paragraphs: Four coordinated color themes with separate day and night choices, plus new always-on display ornaments on AMOLED watches.

whatsNew.title: 1.7–1.8 — More supported watches
paragraphs: Support expanded to the fēnix 9 family and selected Approach S70, Descent, MARQ and D2 models.

images.alt: Time first: an uncluttered watch face reveals optional Widgets, status and weather features.
Weather ahead: the lower-left forecast switches between temperature and rain chance.
Weather that adapts: Weather Signals and Outdoor Brief on the watch face.
One place, your choice: analog and digital clocks, Countdown, Days since, or no Widget.
Your data fields: choose two fields, including weekly swim distance on supported watches.
